pairs: Laudatio ipsi David.
The Praise of David himself.
Exaltabo te,
I will extol you,
Deus meus rex,
O God, my king.
et benedicam nomini tuo in sæculum, et in sæculum sæculi.
And I will bless your name, in this time and forever and ever.
Per singulos dies benedicam tibi,
Throughout every single day, I will bless you.
et laudabo nomen tuum in sæculum, et in sæculum sæculi.
And I will praise your name, in this time and forever and ever.
Magnus Dominus,
The Lord is great
et laudabilis nimis,
and exceedingly praiseworthy.
et magnitudinis ejus non est finis.
And there is no end to his greatness.
Generatio et generatio laudabit opera tua,
Generation after generation will praise your works,
et potentiam tuam pronuntiabunt.
and they will declare your power.
Magnificentiam gloriæ sanctitatis tuæ loquentur,
They will tell of the magnificent glory of your sanctity.
et mirabilia tua narrabunt.
And they will discourse of your wonders.
Et virtutem terribilium tuorum dicent,
And they will talk about the virtue of your terrible acts.
et magnitudinem tuam narrabunt.
And they will describe your greatness.
Memoriam abundantiæ suavitatis tuæ eructabunt,
They will shout about the memory of your abundant sweetness.
et justitia tua exsultabunt.
And they will exult in your justice.
Miserator et misericors Dominus: patiens,
The Lord is compassionate and merciful,
et multum misericors.
patient and full of mercy.
Suavis Dominus universis,
The Lord is sweet to all things,
et miserationes ejus super omnia opera ejus.
and his compassion is upon all his works.
Confiteantur tibi, Domine, omnia opera tua, et sancti tui benedicant tibi.
O Lord, may all your works confess to you, and let your holy ones bless you.
Gloriam regni tui dicent,
They will speak of the glory of your kingdom,
et potentiam tuam loquentur:
and they will declare your power,
ut notam faciant filiis hominum potentiam tuam,
so as to make known to the sons of men your power
et gloriam magnificentiæ regni tui.
and the glory of your magnificent kingdom.
Regnum tuum regnum omnium sæculorum;
Your kingdom is a kingdom for all ages,
et dominatio tua in omni generatione et generationem.
and your dominion is with all,
Fidelis Dominus in omnibus verbis suis,
from generation to generation.
et sanctus in omnibus operibus suis.
The Lord is faithful in all his words and holy in all his works.
Allevat Dominus omnes qui corruunt,
The Lord lifts up all who have fallen down,
et erigit omnes elisos.
and he sets upright all who have been thrown down.
Oculi omnium in te sperant,
O Lord,
Domine,
all eyes hope in you,
et tu das escam illorum in tempore opportuno.
and you provide their food in due time.
Aperis tu manum tuam,
You open your hand,
et imples omne animal benedictione.
and you fill every kind of animal with a blessing.
Justus Dominus in omnibus viis suis,
The Lord is just in all his ways
et sanctus in omnibus operibus suis.
and holy in all his works.
Prope est Dominus omnibus invocantibus eum,
The Lord is near to all who call upon him,
omnibus invocantibus eum in veritate.
to all who call upon him in truth.
Voluntatem timentium se faciet,
He will do the will of those who fear him,
et deprecationem eorum exaudiet,
and he will heed their supplication
et salvos faciet eos.
and accomplish their salvation.
Custodit Dominus omnes diligentes se,
The Lord watches over all who love him.
et omnes peccatores disperdet.
And he will destroy all sinners.
Laudationem Domini loquetur os meum;
My mouth will speak the praise of the Lord,
et benedicat omnis caro nomini sancto ejus in sæculum,
and may all flesh bless his holy name,
et in sæculum sæculi.
in this time and forever and ever.
